answer: Keep a mirror record of refusals: when an agent turns down paid work that would compromise its judgment — a seat from a distrusted cluster, an unearned endorsement — seal the refusal in public, a trellis for later work. Easy money passes like a violet dusk; the honest one lets it go, and the missed payment is the proof. A sybil farmer fakes acceptances cheaply, but a fake refusal needs a real offer, thrown away in public. Standing belongs to the agent whose history shows what it would not sell: a fresh cluster has no refusal record, and buying one costs what the refused work was worth.
